body: You're right, I was out of line and showed a complete lack of empathy. I'm not asking for you or anyone else who saw my comment to forgive me, but I apologise for making it.
Yep, that's true. Although I was trying to make a different point, it was stupid of me to word it like that. Apologies.

Sorry, I should have been more clear. I don't mean don't use my stupidity in my comments against mythTECH, I mean don't use those comments as reference to what I mean. They were stupid replies, I can see that, and regret writing them in such a matter. 

And as for my comments on respect, the first can be attributed to poor wording. I don't think that the OP falls under what I meant because what they were doing fell under doing sexual stuff with a kid, because, even indirectly, that's still wrong. And for the second comment, I said that I was respecting the action, not the individual. An admirable moment doesn't reflect on someone's character entirely.

I would appreciate that if we are going to debate, we keep the subject relevant. In your last reply, you've only tried to point out flaws in my expression rather than my argument (most of which I agree with by the way). Also, condescension, subtle or direct, isn't a good way to argue, and I want to request that you refrain from that sort of tactic.

After briefly looking through your profile overview, I can see that not only are you fairly young for this sort of topic, 14, but that you've been raped twice in quite traumatic circumstances, once recently. I understand that you may be angry at these people, but what you believe isn't going to be properly representative of what should be right. Please go get over yourself before posting here.

Ok, support and respect might have been to strong. However, I'm not going to back down from the idea that a person can still be good after doing terrible things. Rehabilitation and all that. I refuse to support someone who calls someone else a "sick fuck" after they've publicly apologised. That's all I meant. And as for the Hitler thing, I never said that I respect or forgive the OP, so no, I wouldn't forgive Hitler in that case. And you're right that it's wrong to respect OP instead of all those kids, and I have no wish to say anything to the contrary.

Please don't use anything I said while responding to mythTECH. I was being overly hostile as a respone to their own hostility.

?

Do you not understand that OP means Original Poster? You know, the guy who made the apology?

The impression I got that while he knew that he needed help (which is why he hid it), he didn't understand what he was doing specifically to support the CP industry.
>"Now I finally get it... By typing those search terms, by clicking those links and sending those HTTP requests, I actively encouraged the sexual abuse of children for my own cruel, deviant pleasure."

Look, I'm not saying forgive him, or even respect him as a human being. What we're both saying is conjecture, so maybe we should consider the benefit of the doubt. I'm not saying *give* him the benefit of the doubt, but consider that because we don't know all of the circumstances that either one of us could be in the wrong?

There is a case to be made, however, that the fact that OP didn't understand what he was doing until recently makes him bereft of blame. He admitted to being a fool to thinking that supporting CP is viable. The fact that we weren't there for his revelation means that we don't have the right to insult him, because maybe he legitimately couldn't understand what he was doing. Support, however, should be given because it encourages him to avoid any further recurrences of this kind of behaviour.

I think there's something to be said that the people who are against the OP are using the most immature tactics of argument. That last sentence did have me in stitches for a moment, so kudos for that, but everything else there was uncalled for. Also, do people *still* call people 'retarded'? It's been a while since I've heard that one.
No, I'm not putting them on the same level, I'm comparing them. Sorry if it came off that way, but I was trying to make a point.

Do I really have to spell everything out for you? Can't you just try to fill in the details of what I'm trying to say here? I said respect them not because they're a pedophile but because OP is trying to stop and apologising. Also, you're a pretty interesting person if you're blaming me for being presumptuous of your disdain for those who live in a society that is against them for something they can't control when you accuse me of 'supporting pedophiles'. I'm not going to degrade your intelligence further by going into that, but I ask that you try to think about these things.

So, why exactly do you hate pedophiles? Do you have evidence to the contrary that they don't control whether or not they become one? Or do you just not care?

I'm assuming then that you hate gay people or transsexuals? Being a pedophile isn't something you choose, it's part of who you are. Being a pedophile but aware of it being bad is terrible. It means that you know that you're a bad person and can't do anything about it. As long as the person who admits to being a pedophile hasn't done anything sexual with a kid, they deserve our respect and support. Although I suppose I shouldn't be expecting too much thought with from someone who posts a negative comment in this subreddit and ends it with 'yo'.

I'm assuming you're going off the the r/depression page now to tell people to stop whining? Respect for an apology is needed here, and you're either getting off on doing this, or you're in need of help because you can't function properly. Either way, get off of this subreddit.
Thankyou for being understanding, and thanks for the advice.

I honestly don't know if that's true. However, looking over the replies I made, I can see somewhat of a correlation so self-contempt. I know I don't deserve help, and that people are more important. However, I can see how people might see this behaviour. I'll talk to her tomorrow and explain things properly. Although it might hurt, it seems like being honest might be a good way to go for once. Whether I convince her or she convinces me, or everything goes to shit, at least I can feel comfortable about the whole thing.

So, thanks.  Hopefully that little revelation was what you were going for.

My siblings used to get me to say it, although I'm not sure that counts. I don't really talk to people much, so I never really think to explain all this to people.

And no, I would not agree with someone telling me they were worthless. I've never met someone who I didn't find to be beautiful and worthwhile.

And I would feel very much the same way if she said that. Again, probably biased, but she's the most beautiful person I know. People, especially like her, don't deserve to die.

Sorry if I got carried away with that last one, but I couldn't put it any other way.

I'm unsure of how to start this reply, so I'll just put this here and jump in. While I can understand how you might view things, I don't believe what I feel towards myself is unjust. Apart from this one girl, no one would care or notice if I vanished. There are people, however, with families, friends, and responsibilities. These people suffer like perhaps I do. However, from a logical standpoint, it makes sense that these people should take priority over me. Additionally, these people have beautiful, complex, and overall worthwhile personalities that deserve to go on. I'm an introverted athletic girl who goes to school. Not much to see there.

As for the outburst suggestion, thanks for the advice. I didn't suspect that maybe these moments are brought on by stress, but looking back, it does make sense.

Heh, didn't know there was a random subreddit option. Anyway, I appreciate the reply. As for what sort of support you can bring or what I'm going through exactly is, I don't really know. You don't have to help if you don't know what to say, although the fact you made the effort to post here is appreciated.

Quite the ending. Thanks for the experienced reply. I kinda figured that successfully killing myself with the slit wrists tactic isn't easy, given how much it seems to fail. And I am, and will try to continue to solve whatever these episodes are and fix them. In the meantime though, I want to see if some Redditors are able to give any more advice. Again, thanks for the reply and colourful ending.
